title: 大掃除・掃除のイラスト
subject_en: Cleaning tools and chores, each a separate object, clean flat vector style with simple shapes and bright colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: ほうき・バケツ・雑巾・掃除機などを描いた掃除素材です。年末の大掃除や日々の掃除のお知らせに使えます。
items: a bamboo broom with a dustpan
a blue bucket with a wrung cloth over the edge
a spray bottle of cleaner with a blank label
a yellow and green sponge with soap bubbles
a pair of yellow rubber gloves
a floor mop in a bucket
a squeegee wiping a small window pane
a clothesline with a shirt and a towel
a shiny kitchen sink with sparkles
